unit.why: A short memorate quoted from Ramatayim Tzofim: the rebbe of Peshischa promises a son to the author's in-law, whose children kept dying, and orders that the boy's name be hidden and that he be raised in another town. It is set inside a discussion of the custom of concealing a child's name, with a kabbalistic justification from the Ari via the Hida.
unit.boundary_note: Continues the topic (concealing a child's name) of the previous division, but the narrative itself is self-contained.

stories.start_quote: ובס׳ רמ״ץ אות צ״ד כ׳ וז״ל
stories.end_quote: וכל דבריו הקדושים מהיכן נובעים, עכ״ל
stories.summary_en: The rebbe of Peshischa promises R. Zalman, who had lost seventeen children, a son, and orders that the boy's real name never be revealed (he is called 'Alter') and that he be born and raised in Pilov; the boy survives, and the narrator later finds the custom's kabbalistic source in the Ari.

quotes: כאשר הבטיח למחותני ה״ר זלמן ע״ה שיזכה לבן זכר
tags.why: The promise of a son comes true.
The story's arc is a promise that is fulfilled.
A son is promised to a man whose children all died; not strictly childlessness.

quotes: שלא יגלה שם של הילד כלל רק שיקרא אותו אלטער
ועוד צוה שלא יהי׳ בביתו רק יהי׳ ויתגדל בעיר אחרת
tags.why: The rebbe's instructions shield the child from the death that took his siblings.
The central point is protecting the child from death.

quotes: כי היו לו בנים שכולים ולא הי׳ יכול לגדלם
tags.why: Averts the foretold pattern of child deaths.

quotes: ושם נולד ונתגדל שם עד שהי׳ בר מצוה
tags.why: The birth of the promised child is narrated.
The mother acts by travelling to give birth elsewhere.

quotes: וראה כוונת אדמו״ר וכל דבריו הקדושים מהיכן נובעים
tags.why: The narrator later grasps the source behind the rebbe's instruction.

quotes: כי היו הקליפות רבות כי כל מה שהוא באתגליא שלטא ביה עינא
וראה כוונת אדמו״ר וכל דבריו הקדושים מהיכן נובעים
tags.why: Praises the hidden depth of the rebbe's words.
The anecdote is wrapped in a justificatory frame about a custom and its exegetical source (Noah's naming).
